benefits.name: No GM Intrusion on Stealth
benefits.description: You don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1 on a stealth task.

benefits.name: Light Thrown Weapon Damage
benefits.description: You inflict +1 damage with light thrown weapons.

system.description:
Three feet tall and proud of every inch, you are fond of the comforts of home but itching for a little adventure now and then.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • You don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1 on a stealth task.
  • You are trained in escaping.
  • You inflict +1 damage with light thrown weapons.
